name: Awkward Look Monkey Puppet
visual_description: A white caption box above two panels of a brown monkey puppet looking sideways then awkwardly glancing away.
usage_context: Used to express guilt, avoidance, embarrassment, or acting oblivious in uncomfortable situations.

example.caption_text: When the teacher asks who didn't do the homework and you make eye contact

text_areas.description: Top caption describing an awkward or guilty scenario
